$comment: RM-099 — the curated prompt map behind the “Ask your agent” loop. Hand-authored: prompt text, the MCP tool calls to show, and what renders. `blocks` are registry block ids (copy-owned under components/blocks/); `surface` names a site composition for a prompt no library-only block covers. The recorded responses for the offline fallback are GENERATED into content/generated/agent-loop-recorded.json by `pnpm gen --only home` — never typed here.

prompts.text: Build me a KPI overview for churn with a trend and a movers list
A status card that tells me if I should act

args.shape: single value against a target threshold

prompts.text: Show revenue by region on a map
What chart fits monthly retention by cohort?

args.shape: cohort by month, two categorical axes
